newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swap - Gas oil steady on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swap - Gas oil steady on fresh buying.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps were steady at midday on Tuesday after taking a big fall late Monday as fresh buying interest kept prices from slipping further, traders said.
"The market is steady this morning because of some bottom picking and general sentiment that the market might stay at this level for sometime," one trader said.
July paper was last quoted almost unchanged from late Monday at $22.45/$22.65 per barrel, but was down sharply from Monday's intra-day traded high of $23.05, brokers said.
Trading attention shifted to August this morning with several deals heard at $22.83-22.87 with the July/August time spread widening to trade at 35 cents.
July/August traded late last week at 25 cents, brokers said.
August was also quoted steady from Monday at $22.85/$22.95, they said.
Traders said there are some perceptions that the market might have hit bottom at current levels as at this level fresh demand is expected to emerge from China.
A U.S. major sold to a European major a 150,000 barrel cargo on Monday for July 1-5 lifting at $22.20 per barrel free-on-board Singapore, down 60 cents from last Tuesday's traded level.
Traders said at this price the cargoes can be sold into south China at below $175 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis which was the last buying price from there.
Also news of India's new term tender to buy five 45,000 tonne cargoes for August to March delivery should help boost sentiment, they said.
Traders are hoping that the combination of low prices and run cuts by Shell Singapore will entice buyers to come out on expectation that prices have hit a low.
Fuel oil swaps were steady with July last quoted at $100.00/$101.00, brokers said.
Naphtha swaps were down due to poor demand in Japan with July last quoted at $20.80/$21.10, down from Monday's $21.10/$21.30, brokers said.
They said July traded late Monday at $20.975 while August traded at $21.20.
